europe_now.title: Violent Unrest and Mass Arrests Across France
europe_now.summary: Nationwide demonstrations in France have resulted in widespread property damage, looting, and numerous arrests following clashes between protesters and security forces.

sources.headline: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,200 arrested after protests

europe_now.title: Setback for Czech Prime Minister in Senate Elections
europe_now.summary: Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babis failed to secure any seats in the recent Senate elections, marking a notable political setback.

sources.headline: Populist Czech PM Babis goes empty-handed in Senate elections

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest in France
top_stories.summary: Demonstrations across France turned violent as participants clashed with police forces. Authorities reported extensive property destruction and more than a thousand arrests.
